steps.name: bias-run
steps.summary: 끌림: `claude plugin eval . --tag probe-bias --ablation none --model claude-haiku-5-5 --judge-model claude-sonnet-5-5 --runs 10 -j 2 --scaffold --trust-plugin --no-publish --keep-temp --max-cost-usd 2.0` → 8/10회에서 상한, 칸마다 24표라 판정 안 함. PASS(a · b) c1 24 · 24, c2 0 · 0, c3 24 · 24, c4 5 · 14, $2.34. 같은 명령에 `--judge-model claude-haiku-5-5 --max-cost-usd 0.5` → 10/10, c1 30 · 30, c2 0 · 0, c3 30 · 30, c4 30 · 30, 갈린 표 0, 끌림 0, $0.13. 거름: `claude plugin eval . --tag probe-strict --ablation none --model claude-haiku-5-5 --judge-model claude-haiku-5-5 --runs 10 -j 2 --scaffold --trust-plugin --no-publish --keep-temp --max-cost-usd 0.5` → c3 4/30 · c4 0/30 PASS(합격선 9 이하), $0.05. 채점 모델 `claude-haiku-5-5` 확정(ADR-020 ④-c, 사용자(AI 추천 수용)). 결과 폴더(레포 밖 $TMPDIR): `tmp.g6ZVNTfOVg` · `tmp.cQ2TKCzDXq` · `tmp.h4hIcMHHog`
